test_scriptbpe_tokenize: test ScriptBPE tokenize method to split words into BPE tokens using a vocab file
test_scriptwordtokenizer_tokenize: test ScriptWordTokenizer tokenize method to split text into word tokens with character offsets
test_make_byte_inputs: test make_byte_inputs to convert a batch of word lists into padded byte tensors
test_utf8_chars: test utf8_chars function to split a string into its individual UTF-8 characters
test_scriptbpe_pickle: test ScriptBPE serialization by pickling and unpickling a BPE tokenizer loaded from a vocab file
